title: Only reigning Pinoy world boxing champ stakes title vs unbeaten Spaniard

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Filipino world champion Pedro Taduran is set for another important test of his reign when he defends his International Boxing Federation (IBF) minimumweight world title against undefeated Spanish challenger Brandon Moreno on November 7 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA. Interestingly, the upcoming title fight did not receive much attention from mainstream Philippine media until last week, despite Taduran being the country’s lone reigning world boxing champion. Taduran, who holds a 20–4–1 record with 14 knockouts, will put his 105-pound crown on the line against Moreno, an unbeaten challenger carrying a 16–0 record with five knockouts. READ: Pedro […]...
